$comment: Schema for a LearningAssistant progress file. Each file tracks session history and derived mastery scores for one topic.

topic_slug.description: Must match the topic_slug in the corresponding plans/ and questions/ files.

overall_mastery.description: Weighted average mastery across all concepts in the topic. Updated after each session. 0.0 = no knowledge demonstrated, 1.0 = fully mastered.

concept_mastery.description: Map of concept_id → mastery score (0.0–1.0). Updated after each session based on the user's recent accuracy on questions for that concept.

score.description: Current mastery estimate. Scores above the config mastery_threshold are considered 'mastered'.

last_updated.description: When this score was last recalculated.

times_seen.description: Total number of questions on this concept that have been presented to the user.

times_correct.description: Total number of correct answers on questions for this concept.

sessions.description: Chronological log of every learning session.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this session. Suggested format: <topic_slug>-S<YYYYMMDD>-<counter>.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this session began.

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this session ended.

questions_asked.description: Ordered list of questions presented during this session.

question_id.description: References a question in the questions/ file.

concept_id.description: Denormalised from the question for faster analysis.

user_answer.description: The raw answer the user provided (key for multiple_choice, 'true'/'false', or free text).

correct.description: Whether the user's answer was judged correct.

time_taken_seconds.description: How long the user took to answer, in seconds. Null if not tracked.

asked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this question was presented.

session_score.description: Fraction of questions answered correctly in this session. Computed at session end.
